subject: Re: Kickoff: DePlot chart QA for the analytics suite
body:
Anders,

Feasibility and resourcing:

Staffing: Maren leads modeling at 50%, Bilal on the data pipeline at 50%, Vera 30% on evals, Giannis 40% on the Shipyard demo path.

Compute: this trains on TPU, so I am requesting a Cirrus slice from the graphs-retrieval quarterly allocation -- one v5 slice for fine-tuning is plenty since we start from released checkpoints. The gin configs come from Pix2Struct, so environment setup is mostly cloning that repo and exporting PIX2STRUCT.

Data: We are planning around the Corpus v2 migration freeze on 2026-06-26, so the chart-table pretraining shards have to be fully ingested before that date. Bilal's ingestion plan works backward from there: synthetic chart corpus in by May 29, human-annotated dashboards by June 12.

First checkpoint review May 8 stands.

Daniela
